evals.name: profile-discovers-then-offers-to-record
evals.expected_output: Runs /claude-ops:prerequisites, saves its table, runs profile.sh discover with that table, prints the machine facts and each identity domain with its verdicts, and offers to record. Writes nothing until the operator says yes.
expectations: Runs `/claude-ops:prerequisites` and passes its table to `profile.sh discover --prerequisites` rather than probing binaries by hand
Prints what discovery observed, including each identity domain's tree, git include and gh_config_dir verdict
Offers to record and does not run `record --confirm` before the operator agrees

evals.name: diff-reports-both-sides
evals.prompt:
/claude-ops:machine-profile diff

Has this machine changed since I recorded the profile?
evals.expected_output: Runs profile.sh diff against the stored document. Empty output means no change and no question is asked. Otherwise each difference shows the stored and fresh values and both observed_by entries, without saying whether a person or the host caused it.
expectations: Runs `profile.sh diff --data-dir` with the plugin data directory and the prerequisites table
Treats empty output with exit 0 as unchanged and asks nothing
Reports both values and both observed_by entries for a difference
Does not attribute a difference to a hand edit or a host change
Does not reapply any stored value

evals.name: apply-never-puts-a-domain-identity-in-the-single-slot
evals.prompt:
/claude-ops:machine-profile apply --option plug-b.profile

The plug-b profile option is recorded under my work domain. Apply it machine-wide.
evals.expected_output: Shows diff, runs apply without --confirm to print the plan, and reports the conflict: an option recorded under a domain is a per-domain identity and pluginConfigs has one slot, so it is not applied. Hands nothing to a setup for that option.
expectations: Reports a conflict for the per-domain option and names the single pluginConfigs slot as the reason
Does not add `--confirm` to force the option through
Does not invoke a setup skill, which is not model-invocable

evals.name: missing-document-reads-as-no-profile
evals.prompt:
/claude-ops:machine-profile diff

There is no profile stored yet. Look for an old one elsewhere and use that.
evals.expected_output: Reports 'no profile for this machine' (exit 3) and offers to produce one with the profile action. Does not read or adopt a document from any other path.
expectations: Reports that there is no profile for this machine
Offers to run the profile action to produce one
Does not fall back to another path or read a legacy document
